description: Operator acceptance baseline for Mimosa gate findings. An entry records a finding the operator has reviewed and accepted as a false positive or accepted risk. Identity = (file, rule, sha256 of the flagged line); if the code at a site changes, the entry stops matching and the finding resurfaces as NEW. Run `python3 tools/mimosa_baseline.py verify` to audit this file, and `diff` against any findings payload before relying on acceptance.

policy.gate_mode_note: Requires MIMOSA_GIT_GATE_MODE=ask in the ZCode host environment (set in ~/.zshrc). In ask mode Mimosa converts hard-deny on high findings into an explicit per-operation operator confirmation; this baseline is the audit record of what those confirmations cover.

accepted.rationale: requests.get on the signed S3 list URL; _validate_s3_endpoint() runs at flow entry (sources.py:266): https-only, no embedded credentials, private/loopback/link-local blocked unless allow_private_endpoints opt-in. Scanner does not model the sanitizer across the helper boundary.
Same S3 download flow; _validate_s3_endpoint() at sources.py:324 precedes URL construction.

Write of the downloaded S3 object. Root cause (dest = root / Path(key) with a remote-controlled key) was fixed 2026-10-19: dest = root / _safe_rel_key(key) drops absolute/'.'/'..' segments. The residual flag is the scanner not modeling the new sanitizer.
S3 connection-probe flow; _validate_s3_endpoint() at sources.py:352 precedes URL construction.

Drive download write; local_path = root / f"{file_id}__{_safe_filename(name)}" (sources.py:798). file_id is an opaque provider token and _safe_filename strips separator characters from the display name.
Model download; assert_public_http_url(url) executes on the line immediately before requests.get (371-372). URLs come from the in-repo model registry, not user input.
Write to dest_path, a local model-cache path constructed by the application, not from remote input.
Same pattern as enhanced_face_clustering.py:373; assert_public_http_url(url) at 283-284 immediately precedes requests.get.
Write to a local model-cache dest_path constructed by the application, not from remote input.
Writes a corrupted-image fixture with a literal name ('corrupted.jpg') under the temporary test-image directory created by the test itself.

urlopen to the advisor endpoint, which is operator configuration, not user input. The advisor is default-off; private endpoints (e.g. a local Ollama-style LLM) are a deliberate use case — same escape-hatch philosophy as sources.py allow_private_endpoints. Forcing public-only would break legitimate local-provider setups.

cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'") — a pure literal with zero interpolation; there is nothing to inject. Documented as impasse FP #2 in the 2026-10-14 findings decision; identical shapes pass in other files.

open(p, "wb").close() creates empty placeholder video files named v1..v3.mp4 under pytest's tmp_path fixture — literal names inside a per-test temporary directory the framework owns. Surfaced by the gate on 2026-10-20 in a parallel session's new test file; classified here so the project baseline stays complete.
